verdict.rationale: Vestd documents granting share options under EMI schemes and sells 409A valuations for UK companies issuing options to US taxpayers, so the main pieces exist in the product. Nothing shows a board approval flow for option grants, and nothing shows the 409A valuation setting the strike price inside the same grant workflow. The 'board-ready governance' claim is adjacent rather than an approval workflow. Missing for 10: a documented board approval step in the grant flow, the 409A strike price applied automatically at grant, evidence of one end-to-end new-hire workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow

citations.quote: you will need to create the actual EMI scheme so you can grant share options
If you're a UK company issuing options to US taxpayers, you need 409A valuations. Get your 409A valuation from Vestd for a small fee.
